text:
maria_sales: Customer (RegBank EU) wants a short POC. Main asks: 1) Confirm EU-only data path for inference + embeddings (no non-EU subprocessors touching payload), 2) price delta for a 1-month Dedicated reserved pool in eu-west-1 vs hosted with similar throughput, 3) behavior on regional outage (fail closed vs failover).

sam_eng: quick clarification 12: Is the control plane allowed outside EU? If not we need Private control plane or an enterprise agreement for EU-only control plane.

maria_sales: They said control plane telemetry can be global but keys and model tokens must remain in EU. BYOK for KMS requested and tenant pin to eu-west-1.

tess_security: Note: our subprocessors list has a couple of analytics jobs that may touch logs in us-east for processing; need to check if those handle payload or just anonymized telemetry. I'll flag anything that processes request bodies.

omar_ps: For POC speed, Dedicated in eu-west is fastest (~4 business days). Private VPC would be ~3 weeks. We can do a 1-month temporary commitment but finance needs numbers.

billing_bot: rough estimate: Hosted API cost for 2M tokens/day = ~\u20acY/day (placeholder). Dedicated 1-month reserved: base commit + reduced per-token rate; need exact model and q8/q4 details to produce final numbers.

sam_eng: routing config we propose for the POC (shareable snippet):

```
routing:
  tenant: regbank-eu
  region_policy: pinned
  allowed_regions: [eu-west-1]
  failover_policy: fail_closed
kms:
  byok: true
  key_locations: [eu-west-1]
```

sam_eng: If they later accept eu-standby, we can add eu-central as warm standby; that introduces cross-region egress only during failover.

tess_security: Action items from security: 1) verify subprocessors that touch request bodies, 2) provide BYOK attestation steps, 3) confirm audit log residency, 4) prepare a short security addendum for the POC. I'll start the ticket.

maria_sales: cool. Action: @sam_eng confirm standby latency and warm spin-up, @billing_bot produce delta pricing estimate for 2M tokens/day for both hosted and 1-month dedicated commit, @omar_ps draft POC schedule.

omar_ps: ETA: schedule and runbook by EOD tomorrow.

maria_sales: thanks team, I'll update the customer and ask for BRD with exact model mix. :thumbsup:
